sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** Under this scheme, free driving training is provided to scheduled caste and scheduled tribe candidates to improve driving skills and promote self-employment.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Skills & Employment; Sector: Training and Skill Up-gradation

**Detailed Description:** The &quot;Free Training for Vehicle Drivers&quot; scheme was implemented by the Transport Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to enhance driving skills and promote self-employment among scheduled caste and scheduled tribe individuals. Under this scheme, free professional driving training is provided to candidates for light, heavy, and refresher vehicle courses. The scheme also aims to reduce road accidents and improve driving capabilities in the SC/ST communities. The scheme is implemented by the Institute of Driving and Traffic Research (IDTR), Dehradun.

**Benefits / Assistance:** > **Free Driving Training:** - Training is offered in Light Motor Vehicle (Commercial), Heavy Motor Vehicle (Commercial), and Refresher Courses. > **Validity** - There is no fixed validity period. > **Renewal** - No renewal is required. > **Fees** - **Free Training** – Training under this scheme will be completely free of cost. No fee will be charged from the applicant.

**Application Process:** **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the Institute of Driving and Traffic Research (IDTR), Dehradun and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the concerned Institute of Driving and Traffic Research (IDTR). > **Notes:** - After scrutiny of the received applications, admission to the training program will be provided on a first-come, first-served basis. - Applications can be submitted at any time of the year, and training will commence once a batch is formed.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: State Transport Department
**Tags:** Free Training, Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Driving Skills, Self-employment, Vehicle Driver
